Question 4

Let A be the set of all integers less than 0 and let B be the set of all odd integers less than 0. What is A−B?

a
 {0,−2,−4,−6,−8,−10,−12,…}
b
 {−3,−5,−7,−9,−11,−13,−15,…}
c
 ∅
d
 {−1,−3,−5,−7,−9,−11,−13,−15,…}
e
 {−2,−4,−6,−8,−10,−12,…}
